item.title: Apprenticeships crisis threatens small-business growth
item.description: One of Australia’s leading automotive group training organisations is warning that the Government’s decision to cut incentives for small businesses to take on apprentices. Michael Wentworth is the Managing Director of Apprenticeships Are Us Ltd (ARU) – a not-for-profit, that has supported over 7,500 young people into trade careers over 18 years.
